about: Test set for 4.4 progress-report drafts. Each case is what Spring Boot sends the ai-service (ReportInput): one of the five sample grants in ../make_samples.py, plus objectives, outputs and a note for one reporting period. Everything is fictional. Run: ai-service> .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m award.evaluate_reports

cases.tests: A full first-year report: papers (one dated only by year, as ORCID often gives), students, equipment with its cost, milestones, a patent, and a note explaining a delay.
